title: Charge on a Fermat conductor
plain: Put a unit of electric charge on a perfectly conducting body x⁴+y⁴+z⁴ ≤ 1. Show the surface charge is thinnest at the six flat points and thickest at the eight diagonal points.
math: Let $\mu$ be the Newtonian equilibrium measure of $K=\{x^4+y^4+z^4\le1\}$, with density $\rho$ with respect to surface area on $\partial K$. Prove that $\rho$ attains its minimum exactly at $(\pm1,0,0),(0,\pm1,0),(0,0,\pm1)$ and its maximum exactly at $3^{-1/4}(\pm1,\pm1,\pm1)$.
